facts.fact: The Association of Online Press Publishers and Professionals (APPEL), a Senegalese professional body, with Paradigm Initiative, backed 23 MPs' constitutional challenge lodged on 10 March 2026 against the media regulator law (CNRM law) over risks of administrative censorship; the document is Paradigm Initiative's account.

systems.country_label: Conseil national de Régulation des Médias law

note: Council decision of 7 April 2026 struck closure powers of a regulator (not an offence of defamation, false news, sedition or insulting the head of state), so no repealed fact; no cut or punishment reported.
